people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
translations.bsb: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
